draft.title: The Cultural Revolution
card: In 1966 Mao Zedong launched the Cultural Revolution. He said China's revolution was under threat from officials who had taken the capitalist road, and from old ideas and habits.
Mao encouraged students and young people to form Red Guard groups. They were urged to attack officials, teachers and anyone seen as an enemy of the revolution.
Red Guards also attacked the Four Olds: old customs, old culture, old habits and old ideas. Temples, books and art were destroyed.
Many people were publicly humiliated, beaten, jailed or driven to suicide. Schools closed, normal government broke down, and the army was later used to restore order.
draft.remember: Mao used young Red Guards to attack officials and old culture, and the result was chaos and persecution.

a.q: Which statement best describes the role of the Red Guards in the Cultural Revolution?
opts: Young people urged by Mao to attack officials and old culture
Army units sent by Mao to shield officials from public attack
Peasant groups formed to take land from landlords in villages
Party officials who ran the communes during the revolution
a.why: Mao encouraged students and young people to form Red Guard groups and attack officials and the Four Olds. The army was used later to restore order, so it was not the group that carried out the attacks.
a.clue: Think about who Mao urged to act, and who they targeted.

b.q: In 1967 a Red Guard group in a Chinese city seizes a school's old books and humiliates its head teacher in public. Which reason for this fits the aims of the Cultural Revolution?
opts: The books stood for old ideas and the teacher was an enemy
The books were said to hold plans for an invasion of China
The teacher was said to have broken a new national school law
The school was being closed to make room for a new factory
b.why: Red Guards were urged to attack the Four Olds and people seen as enemies of the revolution, so old books and a teacher fit those targets. The other options give reasons that the Cultural Revolution did not rest on.
b.clue: Look for the option that matches who and what the Red Guards were told to attack.
